title: How to Navigate Uncertainty About AI Consciousness
abstract: arXiv:2608.19215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given deep uncertainty about the possibility of artificial consciousness, it is unclear how we should treat potentially sentient AI. On the one hand, we could assume insentience but risk doing terrible harms to entities that deserve moral standing. On the other hand, we could assume sentience and instead risk wasting resources on insentient machines. The intractability of questions around AI consciousness mean that this dilemma is hard to escape. I suggest a way out of that shifts from intractable questions of AI consciousness to tractable questions of AI valence. Specifically, we can assess whether an AI has states that would constitute valenced experiences if it were conscious. I show how this is sufficient to ground a responsible approach to the development of potentially conscious AI.

translated_title: 如何应对人工智能意识的不确定性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19215v1 公告类型：新 摘要：鉴于人工智能意识可能性的深度不确定性，我们不清楚应如何对待可能具有感知能力的人工智能。一方面，我们可以假设其无感知，但冒着对应当享有道德地位的实体造成严重伤害的风险。另一方面，我们可以假设其有感知，却冒着将资源浪费在无感知机器上的风险。人工智能意识问题的难以解决性意味着这一困境难以摆脱。我提出了一种出路，即从难以解决的人工智能意识问题转向可解决的人工智能效价问题。具体来说，我们可以评估人工智能是否具有如果它有意识就会构成效价体验的状态。我展示了这如何足以支撑对潜在有意识人工智能发展的负责任方法。
tldr: 本文提出将难以解决的人工智能意识问题转向可解决的人工智能效价问题，通过评估AI的效价体验状态来指导对其发展的负责任态度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes shifting from intractable questions of AI consciousness to tractable questions of AI valence, using assessments of valenced experience states to guide responsible AI development.
